description: CKEditor plugin dialog code for image insertion and editing, including UI setup, event handling, and attribute management.

methods.name: switchLockRatio
methods.description: Toggles the lock ratio feature for image resizing, updating UI button states.

methods.name: resetSize
methods.description: Resets image dimensions to original size.

methods.name: setupDimension
methods.description: Initializes width or height input fields based on selected image element.

methods.name: onImgLoadEvent
methods.description: Handles successful image load, updates size and preview.

methods.name: onImgLoadErrorEvent
methods.description: Handles image load failure, sets placeholder image.
